notes.title: Update 0.8.2.8
notes.content:
Update 0.8.2.8

Patch notes

-Rearranged racing arrows to be included in scene objects that can be activated / deactivated

-added exclamation warning signs to races.

-Added lighting to titan training messages

-Added music toggle buttons in training menu and pause menu

-Removed unused files, reduced game file size to under 1GB

-Added Orcus cave course racing arrows.

-Added moving obstacles to Orcus advanced training final test

-Modified Orcus floor textures

-Replaced music 'Strange star' with 'Cubes' in Orcus

-Changed music track selection for Orcus

-Mixed and rough mastered Orcus training music

-Fixed solar system time scale bug

-Improved Titam garbage collection

-fixed buggy quit button

-Created better dialogue visuals for Orcus training

-Removed old escape key overlay

-Created rear view toggle button

-Reworked AI activation to be more consistent

-Fixed Mars perimeter medal in racing menu

-Fixed left trigger glitch by clamping input floats

-Disabled Free flight pause menu in opening menu

Details of completed and pending tasks can be found here
https://trello.com/b/OCXwtSyB/hyper-flight

Be sure to stay tuned for more things that nobody asked for or wanted ;->=
